comment: Gzip byte budgets for the website build (improvement list S47, L27, A93). Measured 8 Nov 2026: first-load JS 70.2 kB, first-load CSS 28.1 kB, largest chunk 349.6 kB (pdf.js and pdf-lib, loaded only by the bank and exports), all JS 744.2 kB. Each budget has a little headroom; lower a budget when a change makes the site smaller. Raised totalJs 9 Nov 2026 for the Worksheets page (wave 3): PDFKit browser build 214.6 kB, Anthropic SDK 86.2 kB and OpenAI SDK 90.2 kB, all lazy-loaded only when a teacher downloads a worksheet PDF or uses Make with AI; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1199.1 kB. Raised totalJs 10 Nov 2026 for the Gemini provider in Make with AI: Google GenAI SDK browser build 76.6 kB, lazy-loaded only when a teacher chooses Gemini; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1277.2 kB. Raised totalJs 11 Nov 2026 for the Booklets page: BookletPage chunk 23.4 kB, lazy-loaded only on /booklets, reusing the worksheet PDF and AI chunks; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1334.3 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for booklet Word files: the booklet Word writer chunk 11.9 kB and the resvg WebAssembly loader, both lazy-loaded only when a teacher downloads a booklet Word file; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1373.6 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the construction and elevations diagram families (GM8): about 12 kB of cores reach the lazy-loaded Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1401.1 kB with main's 14 Nov additions. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the final-standard tool work queued together: graph point coordinates, shapes, gradient triangles and inequality regions (about 2 kB each in the lazy graph editor chunk), cubic/reciprocal/exponential tables of values, number-line second scales, and the new lazy-loaded two-way table page; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1394.2 kB before GM8 with the first three; lower this once the queue has merged and been measured. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the constructions and plans-and-elevations website editors: two pages lazy-loaded only on /tools/construction and /tools/elevations; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1437.5 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the two-way table editor (U97): a page lazy-loaded only on /tools/two-way-table, plus its core reaching the lazy Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1455.3 kB with the whole final-standard queue merged. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for worked-solution notes in the editors (U116): the shared Worked notes dialog and the worked-note layer reach the eight lazy-loaded editors with an answers copy; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1467.2 kB. Raised totalJs 15 Nov 2026 for pie charts, pictograms and scatter graphs in Statistical charts (S-2, S-3, S-5): chart-core grew by their renderers, which reach the lazy-loaded charts editor and the Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1477.6 kB. Raised totalJs 15 Nov 2026 for the angle diagrams tool: its page (9.2 kB) lazy-loaded only on /tools/angles, plus its core reaching the lazy Worksheets and Booklets pages and the editors' shared chunk through the diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1490.5 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,540,000 on 15 Nov 2026 for the area and perimeter tool: its page lazy-loaded only on /tools/area, plus its core reaching the Worksheets and Booklets pages and the editors' shared chunk through the diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1518.3 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,550,000 on 15 Nov 2026 for the rebuilt Diagram builder page (picture tiles by strand, three views, favourites, topic catalogue): it now loads on first visit to /tools, so first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1541.6 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,600,000 on 15 Nov 2026 for the factor tree (N-5) and sample space (P-3) editors: two pages lazy-loaded only on /tools/factor-tree and /tools/sample-space, plus their cores reaching the Worksheets and Booklets pages and the editors' shared chunk through the diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1568.1 kB. Lowered firstLoadJs to 75,000 on 15 Nov 2026 with the tool switcher on each diagram tool's name: the switcher, its styles and the tools' search words load with a tool's page, not with the site, and the row of tool links left the first load. Measured first-load JS 73.4 kB and CSS 30.4 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,650,000 on 16 Nov 2026 for the Graph tool's exam-work upgrades needed for worked solutions on every paper (transformations, real-life graphs, curve working, equation curves): graph-core grew and reaches the lazy graph editor and, through the diagram registry, the Worksheets and Booklets pages; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1601.4 kB. The function machine editor (16 Nov 2026, lazy on /tools/function-machine) fits in the same raise: measured all JS 1608.5 kB with it. The written methods editor (16 Nov 2026, lazy on /tools/written-method) fits in the same totalJs raise: measured all JS 1642.1 kB with it. Raised firstLoadJs to 76,000 on 16 Nov 2026 because each new tool adds its registry entry and icon to the site's first load (function machines and written methods, about 0.4 kB together): measured first-load JS 75.1 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,700,000 on 16 Nov 2026 for the nets of 3D shapes editor (GM2.07): a page lazy-loaded only on /tools/nets, plus net-core reaching the Worksheets and Booklets pages through the diagram registry; small tool previews (nets, constructions, function machines) are now separate files, not inlined, so first-load JS fell. Measured all JS 1659.0 kB with written methods, first-load JS 72.9 kB. Box plots, stem-and-leaf diagrams and time series graphs in Statistical charts (16 Nov 2026; renderers in chart-core and cards in the lazy charts editor, reaching the Worksheets and Booklets pages through the diagram registry) fit in the same totalJs raise: measured all JS 1652.0 kB before the nets editor merged, about 9 kB over main's 1642.1 kB.
